scenario: The ego vehicle changes lanes to avoid a slower lead vehicle and then returns to its original lane while another vehicle approaches from behind in the target lane.

ego.behavior: The car changes from the left lane to the right lane to overtake a slower vehicle, then returns to the left lane ahead of the original vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the left lane at a slower speed, remaining ahead of the ego vehicle.
The car travels straight forward in the right lane, approaching from behind the ego vehicle during the lane change maneuver.

spatial_relation: The scenario occurs on a straight multi-lane highway with two lanes in the same direction; the ego starts in the left lane behind a slower lead car, with a faster approaching car in the right lane behind the ego.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must complete the lane change and return maneuver without colliding with either adversarial vehicle; the scenario terminates once the ego has returned to the left lane ahead of the original lead vehicle.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the blue car with curved trajectory arrows; two pink cars are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: Two adversarial cars present. 3. Chronology: Initially ego follows slower left-lane car and faster right-lane car approaches from behind; midpoint ego changes to right lane; ending ego returns to left lane ahead of original lead. 4. Evidence: Curved arrows show ego's lane change path; straight arrows show adversarials' constant forward motion.
